verdict.rationale: The evidence pack confirms ROCm/PyTorch/vLLM/llama.cpp software support for the RX 9070 XT, but it never states the actual VRAM capacity or memory bandwidth of this specific card — the only VRAM figure given ('up to 48GB VRAM') is a generic Radeon-family claim likely referring to workstation Radeon PRO cards, not this consumer SKU. Without a specific published VRAM/bandwidth spec for the 9070 XT, there's no evidence it can hold a 70B-class quantized model (which typically needs 35GB+ even at 4-bit). Missing for 10: an explicit VRAM capacity/bandwidth spec for the RX 9070 XT itself, and any benchmark or hands-on report showing a 70B quantized model actually running on it.
